news.title: ECE welcomes new faculty members
news.body: NC State ECE introduced its two new assistant professors for the 2026-27 academic year, Brittany N. Smith and Wei-Hsi Chen. The piece covers the FORGE Lab's aim to turn robot design from an artisanal process into an engineering discipline driven by first principles and algorithms.

news.title: FORGE Lab starts at NC State
news.body: The lab opens in Research Building IV on Centennial Campus and begins recruiting PhD students.

news.title: Dr. Chen is teaching ECE 455/555, Industrial Robotics Systems
news.body: Offered in the fall semester through the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
